description: Functions MySQL has and MariaDB 11 rejects are unknown to the mariadb dialect, each reported with Q005 rather than accepted to fail on the server: ANY_VALUE, REGEXP_LIKE, BIN_TO_UUID, IS_UUID, UUID_TO_BIN, JSON_STORAGE_SIZE and GROUPING; REGEXP_INSTR, REGEXP_SUBSTR, REGEXP_REPLACE, LAG and LEAD take only the arguments MariaDB takes, so a call passing MySQL's further arguments matches no overload.
